dag_infos.description: New Taipei City indigenous population by single year of age, sex, indigenous registration category and district, from MOI Household Registration open data ODRP015. Village-level source rows are aggregated to district level; single-year age makes 18-35 exact.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市原住民人口（單齡年齡、身分、性別、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP015)
data_infos.dataset_description: ODRP015 提供每一村里、性別、單一年齡及原住民身分的現住原住民人口。DAG 逐頁抓取後在當下只保留新北市 29 個行政區，再由村里聚合到行政區；不把村里明細直接寫入事實表。已驗證民國107至114年底快照，民國115年取當時最後可用的11507快照。單齡年齡使18-35可exact取得。
data_infos.etl_description: Discover one latest available monthly snapshot per ROC year around anchor ROC 114, stopping in each direction after two consecutive years with no RIS data. Fetch every page with COUNTY=新北市 and a browser User-Agent. RIS no-data is HTTP 200 with responseCode OD-0102-S, so responseCode is authoritative. Filter by the first eight digits of district_code while each page is in hand; non-New-Taipei rows are never accumulated. Normalise the BOM and the historical aborigine_registered/aborigine_count aliases by role before validating fields. Parse age labels into integer bounds, map male/female, validate the three indigenous registration categories, aggregate village records to district and city rows, and reconcile the input count to both district and city output on every period. A three-times-other-year-median scale guard fails unknown scope changes; KNOWN_BAD_YEARS is empty.
